requiredFindings.title: The volume sample is charged below the observations it performs
requiredFindings.failureScenario: sample_incarnation debits VOLUME (objects 0, edges 3, bytes 2560) and calls observe_volume. That sampler takes two metadata samples and two observe_filesystem samples around the volume-UUID attribute. descriptor_filesystem_observation_cost is objects 1, edges 2, and bytes covering struct statfs (2168 here) plus the status buffer and the filesystem value; two statfs buffers are 4336 bytes before the outer status reads. Item 9 charges the sample before it runs. Required: debit both filesystem observations at that published cost, plus the two outer status reads and the attribute buffer, before observe_volume runs.

requiredFindings.title: ACL-capture I/O on the config and the marker is reported as custody
requiredFindings.failureScenario: An ACL-capture Io error on opensip.json becomes CONFIG.CUSTODY_REFUSED subject custody, because a ConfigRefusal::Custody inner whose chain row is host I/O is mapped to that subject. The same Io error on project-id.v1 becomes PROJECT.ROOT_CUSTODY_REFUSED subject marker-custody, because observe_marker maps every capture Operation to MarkerCustody. Item 8 assigns I/O to the host I/O row. ProjectChainRefusal already maps DescriptorAclCaptureError::Io to that row, and a failed open of either name already uses it. Required: keep a private-predicate failure on marker-custody and a config custody failure on CONFIG.CUSTODY_REFUSED, and map capture Io to the host I/O row.

requiredFindings.title: installation_read.rs still says the session does not walk from the root
requiredFindings.failureScenario: The v88 row for crates/security/src/custody/installation_read.rs still ends with the sentence that nothing walks from the root again. ReadSession::admit_project_root opens the launch or the explicit path, and the selected root, from / through retained no-follow handles. Required: the row says this entry walks from the filesystem root. The project_chain.rs description still describes the chain walk; its configuration-file arm is unstated and no sentence there is false.
